title: Staff Engineer/ SDET Role with C#.Net
description:
**Overview**
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.
  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.
  
  
**Business Segment Overview**
**Corporate:**
Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
****Position Purpose****
The candidate should actively evaluate new products and technologies to build solutions that can streamline business operations. They must be delivery-focused with solid skills in automation of tests for API’s and windows services. They will be required to be involved in technical discussions with the Team or Technical Lead. The candidate will be working on the company public REST API’s used by our platforms and partners to provide them with full trading functionality including authentication, trading, charting, and much more.
  
  
You’ll be an essential part of a highly skilled product team, collaborating with other engineers, tech leads, and QAs to build scalable, high-performing systems used by thousands of clients.
  
  
**Technology Ecosystem**

* Technologies, Languages & Frameworks: nUnit, C#, .NET Core, Postman, Swagger, RestSharp, Allure, NBomber, OpenSearch, Grafana, Jagger
* Architecture: Microservices, Event-driven (Kafka, AMQ), CQRS
* Cloud & Infra: Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Rancher, TeamCity, Octopus, Grafana
* Databases: MS SQL Server (T-SQL), NoSQL, Postgres
* Tooling: GitHub, Visual Studio/Rider, ReSharper
* AI Tools: MS Copilot, GitHub Copilot

**Primary Duties Will Include**

* Define automation-first test strategy and quality gates early with product, developers, and BAs, translating requirements into measurable coverage, risk-based priorities, and release criteria.
* Own and evolve the automated test architecture (frameworks, patterns, reusable components), ensuring maintainability, scalability, and consistent engineering standards across repositories.
* Design and implement robust automated tests (API/service, component, end-to-end, and contract/compatibility), including BDD specifications, test data management, and deterministic execution.
* Establish and run performance and reliability testing (baseline, regression, load) and translate results into actionable engineering feedback to improve latency, stability, and user experience.
* Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines to provide fast feedback loops (reporting, trends, flaky-test detection, artifacts) and ensure failures block releases when quality thresholds are not met.
* Lead defect prevention and rapid root-cause analysis , including log/telemetry review and failure triage, partnering with engineers to drive fixes and reduce recurrence through systemic improvements.
* Own testing across environments and release readiness , coordinating with Service Delivery/Release teams, adhering to change processes, and validating production behavior post-release.
* Driving process/tooling improvements and influencing cross-team quality standards through documentation and knowledge sharing.

**Qualifications**
**To land this role you will need**
:
  
  

* 3+ years of hands‑on experience in Test Automation, with strong proficiency in C# and automation frameworks.
* Solid experience testing distributed systems, including RESTful, SOAP, gRPC APIs, Windows services, and messaging platforms such as Kafka or ActiveMQ.
* Strong test automation skills , including BDD approaches (preferably SpecFlow/Reqnroll), debugging, code reviews, and building custom automation tools and utilities.
* Experience testing web and client‑server applications , with good understanding of databases and SQL.
* Practical knowledge of containerized and orchestrated environments , such as Docker, Kubernetes, or similar platforms, including deployment and release workflows.
* Deep understanding of the full software testing lifecycle , from requirements analysis through QA/UAT sign‑off and production release, within an Agile delivery model.
* Strong grasp of QA best practices, SDLC , and experience working with version control, build, deployment, and test management tools.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills , with do main knowledge in financial systems (e.g. Trading platforms, CFDs, Forex, real‑time data) considered a strong plus.

****Education****

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related field — or equivalent hands-on experience.

title: Staff Quality Engineer - SDET
description:
**Strength in Trust**
OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
  
  
The Challenge
  
  

* We are looking for a Staff level SDET to support our product development teams. As the Staff SDET, you will play a crucial role in shaping and leading our software testing strategy. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing robust test automation frameworks, mentoring a team of SDETs (Software Development Engineer in Test), and ensuring the overall quality and reliability of our software products.

**Your Mission**

* Provide technical leadership and guidance to the SDET team.
* Collaborate with development and QE (Quality Engineering) teams to integrate testing into the software development process.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient test automation frameworks and test architectures.
* Rub shoulders with developers in writing unit and integration tests using their tools and frameworks.
* Ensure the frameworks support various testing types, including functional, integration, and performance testing.
* Mentor and guide junior SDETs, providing technical expertise and career development support.
* Conduct training sessions to enhance the skills of the testing team.
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop comprehensive test plans.
* Execute and oversee the execution of test cases, ensuring thorough coverage of functional and non-functional requirements.
* Analyze test results and provide meaningful insights to improve product quality.
* Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and user stories.
* Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, providing clear updates on testing progress and issues.
* Add, maintain, and update scripts in existing automation suite, helping with running the suite across various checkpoints in the release cycle.
* Participate in various POCs (Proof of Concept) to keep the automation framework and technology relevant and current to product offerings.
* Conduct peer reviews of test code and automation frameworks.

**You Are**

* You are a seasoned SDET with an automate anything anywhere attitude who is looking for a challenging technical leadership role in a dynamic and innovative company.
* You can efficiently find the underlying cause of a failure (in an integrated environment) and alert the right team.
* You are consistently willing to pitch in to support a long running deployment, even after hours.
* You are willing to learn and pick up new skillsets to support the ever-changing technology landscape like Cloud computing & AI (Artificial Intelligence).
* You can understand complex product and deployment architectures and create efficient test solutions.
* You want to be part of a team that is passionate about delivering high-quality software solutions.

**Your Experience Includes**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical or business field.
* 10+ years of relevant experience working as a developer, automation engineer or SDET.
* 8+ years of experience coding in Java and must have strong practical knowledge of OOPs and Core Java principles.
* 4+ years of experience contributing to Test-Driven Development or BDD (Behavior Driven Development) with tools like Cucumber, Junit, Mockito, or TestNG.
* 3+ years of experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Circle CI, or Azure DevOps with the ability to create test pipelines using Java or Groovy.
* 4+ years of experience with Selenium or Cypress frameworks for automating GUI (User Interface) and E2E tests of the application.
* 4+ years of experience with REST Assured or similar tools like Postman for automating APIs.
* 4+ years of experience working in a highly automated CI/CD environment.
* 4+ years of experience with source control tools such as Bitbucket, GitHub or GitLab.
* 2+ years of experience mining meaningful logs for troubleshooting using tools like Splunk, Dynatrace or Coralogix.
* 3+ years of experience working in a cloud shop preferably Azure with exposure to various Azure services like Gateways, Redis, Storage, VMs (virtual machines) and Kubernetes clusters.
* 3+ years of experience in testing mobile applications, both native and websites using Appium on both real devices and simulators either in a private farm of 3rd party vendors like Sauce Labs or BrowserStack.
* 4+ years of experience working with geographically distributed teams in US, Canada, and India.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work as part of a team, demonstrate initiative, solve problems independently and mentor others.
* Passion for high quality work and attention to detail.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.

**Extra Awesome**

* Prior exposure to AI/ML systems and how to use them in testing thus making test pipeline more intelligent.
* Experience in analyzing the CPU Utilization, Memory usage, Network usage, Garbage Collection and DB Parameters and DB Reports to verify the performance of the applications.
* Ability to spin up scalable test architecture using Docker or Kubernetes.
* Experience with Kubernetes and extended usage patterns for test grids, auto scale properties.

Where we Work
  
  
We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
  
  
Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
  
  
**Benefits**
As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
  
  
Resources
  
  
Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
  
  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data
  
  
You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
**.**
You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
  
  
Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
  
  
**Our Commitment to You**
When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
  
  
OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

title: AI QA/QC Engineer Intern
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a curious and detail-oriented intern to help test AI-powered products for accuracy, safety, and reliable behavior. Can you make AI invent an answer, ignore an instruction, contradict itself, or act outside its intended purpose? You will explore these failures, document them clearly, and work with engineers to verify fixes. This role combines manual testing with basic scripting. It suits someone who enjoys experimenting with AI, stays patient through repeated attempts, and speaks up about problems and possible solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Take initiative in choosing what to test next, exploring new failure cases, and sharing findings without waiting for detailed instructions.

- Turn product requirements into test cases covering expected behavior and possible failures. Ask questions when the expected result is unclear.

- Test everyday conversations, unusual inputs, spelling variations, unclear requests, and longer conversations.

- Explore jailbreak attempts: prompts designed to make AI ignore its rules or instructions.

- Check for invented facts, inconsistent answers, inappropriate responses, and unnecessary refusals to valid requests.

- Investigate failures through repeated attempts. Record how often they occur and the conditions that trigger them.

- Write clear bug reports with inputs, conversation history, reproduction steps, expected behavior, and actual results.

- Use basic Python or JavaScript scripts to send API requests, repeat tests, and compare responses.

- Maintain test cases and rerun them after changes to check that earlier problems have not returned.

- Explain which issues need attention first and why. Discuss findings and possible improvements with engineers.

- Follow up on reported problems and confirm whether fixes resolve them.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Curiosity about AI and a strong interest in finding out how and why it fails.
* Patience for trial and error, including repeated tests that do not immediately reveal a problem.
* Attention to detail and clear, organized documentation.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with a willingness to raise problems, ask questions, and explain your thinking.
* Basic Python or JavaScript skills: enough to read and modify simple scripts.
* A basic understanding of APIs, including sending requests and reading JSON responses.
* The ability to check AI answers against supplied facts and instructions, even when an answer sounds confident.
* Willingness to learn from feedback and improve your testing approach.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with Git, Postman, or curl.
* Exposure to manual testing, bug reporting, or automated tests.
* Personal experiments with AI chatbots, jailbreak prompts, or small coding projects.
* Experience testing conversations in more than one language.

Professional experience is not required. Experienced applicants are welcome if the internship's responsibilities and terms suit them. Some testing may involve sensitive or harmful content. Testing will take place within company-authorized environments.

description:
**#RunwiththePack**
At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to
**end cyber risk**
.
  
  
We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.
  
  
More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.
  
  
We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.
  
  
**About The Position**
Job Description
  
  
**About The Role**
The Arctic Wolf security operations platform ingests and processes upwards of 600 billion events a day from a wide variety of on-premise devices and cloud platforms. The security pipeline is a distributed system of loosely-coupled microservices that constitute our Realtime analysis and threat detection systems. These services distil the incoming events into actionable intelligence that our Concierge Security Teams use to protect customers.
  
  
We are looking for experienced quality engineers to join our pack and work with us to build and expand the capabilities of our testing platform.
  
  
**You Will**

* Create and extend software frameworks and tools to run, monitor, and report on automated tests. Have experience building and maintaining Automation frameworks and CI/CD pipeline.
* Review testing strategies, approaches, and test plans and provide insight to development teams.
* Architect, design and build software to automate a variety of testing methods (e.g. API validation, performance/load testing, fuzzing, etc.)
* Develop and maintain test frameworks for GenAI-based and AI/ML applications, including model validation, LLM prompt-response consistency, hallucination detection, and regression testing for AI inference APIs.
* Implement evaluation pipelines to test LLM accuracy, latency, bias, toxicity, and reliability.
* Work as part of a team of highly skilled software professionals.
* Continuously learn and expand your technical horizons
* Our Technology Stack: Selenium, Playwright, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, SQS, S3, etc.), LangChain, LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas), OpenAPI, Postgres, Linux.

**You**

* Are excited to work at the intersection of AIML, Big Data and the Cybersecurity problem space
* Have 2 - 4 years of experience shipping quality software
* Love driving high software quality
* Have experience deploying services on cloud computing platforms (e.g, AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Are an expert using common tools for executing functional, load and fuzz testing (e.g. Locust, CATS)
* Have worked on distributed systems and microservices architecture (preferred)

**About Arctic Wolf**
At Arctic Wolf, we’re cultivating a collaborative and productive work environment that welcomes a diversity of backgrounds, cultures, and ideas to make our teams even stronger as we grow globally. We’ve been named one of the 50 Most Innovative Companies in the world for 2022 (Fast Company)—and the 2nd Most Innovative Security Company. We have won countless awards for our excellence in security operations and remain dedicated to providing an industry-leading customer and employee experience including:
  
  
Top Workday USA (2021-2024)
  
  
Great Place to Work (2022-2024) & Best Workplaces for Women (2024) in Canada
  
  
Best Workplaces in Tech & For Women in the UK (2023)
  
  
Top Company by Kununu in Germany (2024)
  
  
**Our Values**
Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.
  
  
We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here. Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Please let us know if you require any accommodations by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf.com.

Background checks are required for this position.

**Role Title :**
AVP , Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect ( L11 )
  
  
**Company Overview:**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Quality Engineering Center of Excellence (QE COE) is a centralized team of Quality Engineering Leaders and Test Architects, that standardizes, scales, and governs software quality, test automation, and best practices across the organization. This team works closely with the Leaders in the Engineering verticals and other cross functional teams who are the key stakeholders. This role will work closely with other peer Test Architects in the team under the leadership of the QE Leader to rollout and institutionalize the AI driven QE strategies and solutions conceptualized by the team, in partnership with the Application Teams.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect**
Drive the design and delivery of next-generation Quality Engineering solutions by blending proven testing methodologies with AI-powered approaches. This role will occasionally architect scalable testing frameworks, champion adoption of AI-assisted testing, and embed intelligent automation across the product development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate high-quality delivery.
  
  
As an SME in AI-enabled test automation engineering, this role will partner with peer architects and stakeholders to define strategy, recommend the optimal tool stack aligned to the application landscape, and resolve complex automation challenges—delivering best-in-class, enterprise-wide automation expansion solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and own scalable test automation frameworks for functional, regression, and non-functional testing; embed automation into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub, CloudBees) as required by the Application teams.
* Define and drive QE standards, best practices, and reusable libraries/patterns across engineering teams.
* Partner with QE leads in application teams to implement shift-left testing and quality-by-design.
* Design and implement AI-assisted testing solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows; lead prompt engineering and context design for reliable AI test agents (test generation, test data creation, defect triage/analysis).
* Drive adoption and standardization of modern automation tools/frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Selenium).
* Enable self-service automation and quality reporting dashboards for engineering teams.
* Act as a QE technical leader, run architecture reviews, mentor QE Engineers/Architects on AI-driven quality patterns and tools, and resolve complex automation challenges.
* Create playbooks, training, and rollout plans; continuously evaluate/pilot emerging QE technologies and measure adoption and impact.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience: 12+ years in Software Quality Engineering, including 3+ years in test architecture and framework design.
* Automation Tools: Hands-on expertise in Playwright and/or Selenium, REST API testing, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript or Python automation frameworks.
* AI-Assisted Testing: Working knowledge of LLMs and context design for QE use cases.
* Experience in providing AI-assisted solutions for functional, UAT, performance and security testing.
* AI Tooling: Experience applying AI tools for test case generation, code review support, and defect triage.
* Agentic Workflows: Understanding of agentic AI patterns to build autonomous test agents and end-to-end workflows.
* Integration: Ability to integrate AI solutions with existing business processes and enterprise IT infrastructure
* Communication & stakeholder management: Align and influence stakeholders through clear, concise communication.
* System thinking & architecture design: Design scalable QE architectures with end-to-end perspective.
* Problem formulation & solution design: Turn vague problems into measurable, practical solutions.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience designing and building GenAI platforms.
* Exposure to cloud ecosystems such as AWS and Azure.
* Proven ability to integrate test automation into CI/CD toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CloudBees).

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 12 + years of experience in Information Technology or Engineering.

**About Vialto Labs (VLabs)**
Vialto Labs (VLabs) is responsible for redesigning how work is delivered in the tax and immigration service lines, as well as driving operational efficiency across Vialto’s functional areas using AI. The team builds and deploys novel AI-enabled solutions that directly improve productivity and increase delivery quality for our clients. VLabs is accountable for rapidly turning innovative experiments into production-ready deliverables at scale and embedding them into day-to-day operations. This team focuses on the highest-impact workflows, creating standardized, repeatable capabilities that can be deployed globally. Operating with a mandate for speed and measurable outcomes, VLabs works alongside service line, product, and platform leaders.
  
  
**About The Role**
AI Test Engineering is a hands-on role within VLabs Quality Engineering, responsible for validating the performance, reliability, and integrity of AI-enabled solutions in production environments. This role operates at the intersection of AI engineering and quality assurance, ensuring that outputs from LLMs, OCR pipelines, document classification models, and agentic workflows perform as expected at scale and meet defined business performance thresholds. Working closely with the Programme Test Manager and partnering with engineering, product, and delivery teams, this role translates AI testing strategy into executable frameworks, evaluation pipelines, and reusable assets embedded into the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
Success requires independent execution, strong technical depth, and the ability to proactively identify risks, patterns, and performance gaps while enabling rapid, production-grade deployment of AI capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Evaluation & Test Design**

* Translate AI testing strategy into executable test scenarios across LLM outputs, document classification, extraction accuracy, agent workflows, and edge cases
* Design adversarial and boundary test inputs to expose hallucination, misclassification, and failure modes
* Validate AI outputs for structure, consistency, accuracy, and production readiness against defined performance thresholds

**Evaluation Engineering & Automation**

* Build reusable Python-based evaluation frameworks, including output validation, hallucination detection, and scoring mechanisms
* Develop parameterized test scripts reusable across features, models, and releases
* Implement AI-as-Judge frameworks, including prompt design, scoring logic, and calibration of evaluation reliability
* Embed evaluation frameworks into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and deployment

**Drift Detection & Quality Monitoring**

* Design and operate drift detection frameworks using fixed baseline datasets and scheduled re-evaluation
* Establish thresholds to distinguish acceptable variation from performance degradation
* Enable release gating by identifying regressions prior to production deployment

**Ground Truth & Data Quality**

* Build and maintain ground truth datasets in partnership with subject matter experts
* Define standards for classification, extraction accuracy, and acceptable output characteristics
* Continuously update datasets to reflect evolving business requirements and use cases

**Workflow & Integration Testing**

* Test end-to-end agentic workflows, validating data integrity, error propagation, and fallback behavior
* Perform API-level testing of AI pipeline endpoints using Python and Postman/Newman
* Validate data persistence and integrity across system layers using SQL
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure testability, observability, and system reliability

**Standardization & Scaling**

* Define and scale standardized AI evaluation patterns and reusable quality frameworks across VLabs
* Contribute to enterprise AI quality standards and reference architectures

**Governance & Responsible AI**

* Ensure adherence to Responsible AI, data privacy, and governance requirements
* Support auditability, traceability, and transparency of AI outputs and evaluation processes

**Stakeholder Enablement**

* Translate evaluation results into actionable insights for engineering, product, and business stakeholders
* Support decision-making on model readiness, release risk, and performance trade-offs
* Proactively identify risks, patterns, and systemic issues and escalate appropriately

**Qualifications & Experience**
**Professional Experience**

* 7+ years in software testing, including 2–3 years focused on AI/ML-enabled systems in production environments
* Proven experience designing and executing AI evaluation frameworks and quality strategies
* Strong track record building ground truth datasets, drift detection systems, and scalable evaluation pipelines
* Experience testing multi-step agentic workflows and AI-driven automation systems
* Experience operating in fast-paced, iterative delivery environments
* Background in regulated or compliance-driven environments preferred

**Technical Expertise**

* Advanced Python programming for evaluation frameworks, batch processing, and data analysis
* Experience with LLM evaluation tools such as deepeval, RAGAS, promptfoo, or similar
* Strong capabilities in:
* AI output validation, hallucination detection, and grounding checks
* Drift detection frameworks and statistical evaluation methods
* OCR, VLM, and document AI testing (classification, extraction, edge cases)
* API testing using Python (requests/httpx) and Postman/Newman
* SQL for data validation and pipeline integrity checks
* Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks
* Experience with cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry or AWS Bedrock preferred

**Operating Capabilities**

* Ability to operate independently in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
* Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and quality rigor
* Ability to balance speed and rigor in AI evaluation and delivery cycles
* Proactive communicator who identifies risks and drives resolution
* Ability to translate technical findings into business-relevant insights

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree required
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field preferred

**Additional Information**

title: Salesforce QA Automation Engineer
description:
**About SolidCAM**

Founded by Dr. Emil Somekh in 1984, SolidCAM has been a global leader in CAD/CAM software and advanced manufacturing solutions. Our innovative technology integrates seamlessly with market-leading 3D CAD systems, enhancing efficiency, productivity, and the quality of machining and industrial manufacturing processes.Our flagship product is fully solid-based and 100% integrated with leading CAD platforms, including SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor, and SolidEdge. Recognized for over a decade as the fastest-growing CAM software in market share by CIMData, we deliver cutting-edge solutions for CNC machining and 3D printing.

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a Salesforce QA Automation Engineer to own end-to-end quality across our Salesforce platform, applications, integrations and releases. This is a hands-on role covering functional testing, test automation, API and integration testing, backend data validation, security and CI/CD.

The ideal candidate combines strong Salesforce QA and automation experience with the ability to understand how functionality, data, business processes and integrations work together. You will work closely with Salesforce developers, administrators, architects and business teams to identify risks, investigate issues and ensure reliable, high-quality releases.

Clear and effective communication is important, as you will need to explain technical issues clearly and collaborate with different stakeholders globally.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Own functional and automated testing across Salesforce applications and business processes.
* Design comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, test data and regression suites.
* Test Salesforce objects, fields, relationships, Lightning UI, Flows, validation rules, approvals and business automation.
* Develop and maintain automated tests using
  **Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, WebdriverIO or equivalent frameworks**
  .
* Build reusable automation components, frameworks, page/object models, assertions and reporting.
* Validate Salesforce backend data using
  **SOQL**
  and Salesforce tools.
* Perform REST/SOAP API testing using Postman, REST Assured or equivalent tools.
* Test Salesforce integrations with external systems, including request/response validation, error handling and integration outcomes.
* Support
  **SIT, UAT, regression, smoke and end-to-end testing**
  .
* Investigate automation failures and determine whether the root cause is related to application functionality, automation code, test data, configuration, integration or environment.
* Validate Salesforce security scenarios involving Profiles, Permission Sets, Sharing and Field-Level Security.
* Execute automated regression suites and analyse logs, screenshots, reports and test results.
* Integrate automated testing into
  **CI/CD pipelines**
  and work with Git/source control.
* Manage defects through their complete lifecycle using Jira, Azure DevOps or similar tools.
* Work closely with Salesforce developers, administrators, architects, business analysts and business stakeholders.
* Contribute to quality standards, test strategy, automation practices and continuous improvement.
* Support release validation and production defect analysis.
* Help identify opportunities to increase test automation coverage and reduce regression effort.

**What We're Looking For**

* **4–5 years of QA/testing experience**
  , with significant hands-on Salesforce testing experience.
* Strong practical knowledge of Salesforce application and configuration testing.
* Hands-on experience with
  **Salesforce functional and automation testing**
  .
* Strong experience with test scenarios, test cases, test data, execution evidence and regression testing.
* Hands-on experience with at least one automation framework such as
  **Selenium, Playwright, Cypress or WebdriverIO**
  .
* Working knowledge of
  **Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or another automation programming language**
  .
* Ability to write and use
  **SOQL**
  for Salesforce data validation.
* Experience testing Salesforce Flows, validation rules, approvals and record-triggered automation.
* Experience with
  **REST/SOAP API testing**
  and integration testing.
* Experience supporting SIT, UAT, regression, smoke and end-to-end testing.
* Understanding of Salesforce security, including Profiles, Permission Sets, Sharing and FLS.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD platforms such as
  **Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab or Azure DevOps**
  .
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical issues clearly.

**You'll Thrive Here If You...**

* Don't just report a defect — you investigate
  **why it happened**
  .
* Enjoy understanding complex Salesforce business processes.
* Like testing beyond the UI and validating what is happening in the backend.
* Think about negative scenarios, edge cases and failure conditions.
* Enjoy building automation rather than repeatedly executing manual regression tests.
* Can distinguish between an application defect, automation defect, data issue, integration issue and environment problem.
* Take ownership of quality instead of treating QA as the final step in development.
* Like improving existing test frameworks and processes.
* Can explain technical problems in simple business language.
* Enjoy working closely with developers and challenging solutions constructively.
* Want to help establish long-term Salesforce quality and automation standards.

**Good to Have**

* Salesforce Administrator or Platform App Builder certification.
* Salesforce Platform Foundations certification.
* Experience with
  **Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud**
* Strong Selenium WebDriver, Playwright or Cypress framework development experience.
* API automation using REST Assured or equivalent.
* Experience with Salesforce DX, Salesforce CLI and sandbox/scratch environments.
* Experience with performance, load or security testing.
* Experience testing Salesforce Files, ContentDocument, ContentVersion and ContentDocumentLink.
* Experience testing asynchronous Salesforce processing, scheduled jobs and integration retry/error handling.
* Experience validating large data volumes and data migrations.
* Experience creating automation dashboards, reports and quality metrics.
* ISTQB or other recognized QA certification.

**Contract or Full-Time**

We're open to both experienced consultants and candidates looking for a permanent opportunity.

Many great long-term hires begin by working together on a consulting basis. If there's a strong mutual fit, we're happy to discuss a permanent QA leadership or senior engineering opportunity.

We're far more interested in
**your thinking, ownership, technical depth and problem-solving approach**
than simply the tools listed on your CV.

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.
  
  
**Required Technical And Domain Skills**

* Strong automation programming in TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Python or comparable languages.
* Experience with UI, API, GraphQL, integration, data and end-to-end test design.
* Strong SQL/data validation, REST/SOAP integration and batch or migration workflow testing.
* CI/CD, containers, test data, observability and defect analysis in a cloud-native environment.
* Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes.
* Ability to explain quality risk and evidence in clear English across time zones.

Modern platform skills for this role
  
  

* Automate contract and event-integration checks, secure pipeline controls, release/upgrade/rollback evidence, and migration reconciliation. Make failures observable and useful to developers; apply container or orchestration test environments when relevant to the suite.

**Preferred Skills**

* Hands-on L4G/4GL or Progress 4GL, Crystal Reports, SQL Server/Oracle or Web/Syracuse testing.
* Working X3 domain knowledge and understanding of metadata, customisation and upgrade risk.
* Contract testing, performance testing, accessibility, security or chaos/resilience testing.
* Migration comparison tooling, synthetic monitoring or golden customer datasets.
* Cloud environments and partner certification.

**Experience And Qualifications**
Typically 6+ years in quality engineering or software automation, with ownership of automation for a substantial product area. Degree or equivalent experience in computing, engineering or a related discipline.
  
  
Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications.
  
  
Expected outcomes / success measures
  
  

* The squad has a trusted regression signal for the highest-risk customer and migration paths.
* Quality gates run consistently in delivery pipelines and failures are diagnosed promptly.
* Migration and upgrade evidence supports predictable go/no-go, hypercare exit and rollback decisions.
* Manual regression effort and escaped defects reduce without reducing meaningful coverage.

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.
  
  
Key stakeholders and collaboration model
  
  
Works with Software Engineers, Senior/Principal Automation Engineers, Product, Architects, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services and migration/partner teams across India, Europe and North America.

Customer Focus, Accountability, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Challenges weak evidence respectfully, follows risk to impact and helps the whole squad own quality.

title: Senior SDET - Automation Testing
description:
**Overview**
We are seeking a Senior SDET with strong automation engineering skills and hands-on experience in AI applications within quality assurance processes. You will ensure the quality of assigned features and workstreams, develop reusable automation solutions, and incorporate AI-assisted methods in daily tasks.
  
  
This is a senior individual contributor position that requires technical independence, where you'll work closely with developers, product managers, and other QA engineers to define quality standards, establish testing methodologies, and drive measurable improvements in test coverage.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities:**
As a Senior SDET, you will:
  
  

* Take ownership of the quality of assigned features or workstreams from planning to release.
* Define appropriate testing strategies and methods based on feature requirements.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams during requirement reviews and design discussions.
* Monitor quality indicators (defects, coverage gaps) and implement necessary actions.
* Build and maintain automation frameworks that cover critical scenarios.
* Develop reusable automation components that are reliable and scalable.
* Introduce AI solutions to enhance QA workflows, including intelligent test generation.
* Actively participate in code reviews, document designs, and share knowledge with the team.
* Produce reliable test reports and summaries for stakeholders.
* Contribute to CI/CD processes and improvement of execution strategies as needed.

**Key Requirements:**

* Proven track record of ownership over quality in features or workstreams.
* Strong understanding of test strategy and the balance between manual/automated testing.
* Expertise in Playwright and/or Selenium WebDriver.
* Proficient in TypeScript, Python, or C# (.NET).
* Experience with BDD frameworks (Cucumber, Gherkin, structured definitions).
* API testing proficiency and knowledge of complex API interactions.
* Strong SQL skills for data validation and testing data setup.
* Hands-on experience with AI, particularly using LLM APIs for QA (Claude, OpenAI).
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Independent and reliable in delivering quality solutions on time.

**Nice to Have:**

* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
* Experience with test management tools (Azure Test Plans or equivalent).
* Basic understanding of ETL processes and data pipelines.
* Knowledge of Databricks or similar data platforms.

**Other Details:**
This position allows for remote work flexibility. Candidates should have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, with over 5 years of experience in QA and test engineering, showcasing effective contributions in AI-driven projects.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer Test
description:
**About Us:**

Mobileum is a leading provider of Telecom analytics solutions for roaming, core network, security, risk management, domestic and international connectivity testing, and customer intelligence. More than 1,000 customers rely on its Active Intelligence platform, which provides advanced analytics solutions, allowing customers to connect deep network and operational intelligence with real-time actions that increase revenue, improve customer experience, and reduce costs. Know our story: https://www.mobileum.com/

Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Mobileum has global offices in Australia, Dubai, Germany, Greece, India, Portugal, Singapore and UK with global HC of over 1800+.

Join Mobileum Team At Mobileum we recognize that our team is the main reason for our success. What does work with us mean? Opportunities!

Role: SDET – Test Automation

Reports To: Technical Lead – SDET

**About the Job:**

We are hiring SDETs to design, build, and maintain automated tests for Mobileum's telecom products. You will write high-quality automation code, expand coverage across UI/API/E2E layers, integrate tests into CI/CD, and help ensure the accuracy, reliability, and performance of complex, cloud-native systems.

This is a coding-centric quality role — you'll build automation as engineering assets and partner closely with developers and your Technical Lead.

**Roles & Responsibility:**
-

Test Automation

• Design and build automated tests across UI, API, integration, and E2E layers.

• Contribute to and extend shared automation frameworks and utilities.

• Create and maintain reliable regression suites; drive down flakiness.

**Quality Engineering:**

• Perform functional, integration, regression, and data validation testing.

• Write clear, reproducible defect reports with strong root-cause analysis.

• Validate service behavior, API contracts, and data integrity in distributed systems.

**CI/CD Integration:**

• Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitHub Actions/GitLab CI).

• Support shift-left testing and automated quality gates.

• Help maintain test environments (Docker/Kubernetes/OpenShift).

**Collaboration:**

• Work with developers, the SDET Tech Lead, and DevOps to build in testability.

• Translate telecom/roaming requirements into concrete test scenarios. Continuously improve coverage based on production and pre-production findings. © Mobileum. Proprietary and Confidential.

**Desired Profile:**

Programming & Frameworks

• Proficient in Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript.

• Hands-on with Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress; TestNG/PyTest.

• API testing: RestAssured / Postman.

**Engineering Practices:**

• CI/CD integration and Git-based workflows.

• Understanding of SDLC, test design techniques, and quality metrics.

• Exposure to Docker/Kubernetes for test environments.

**Telecom Domain:**

• Familiarity with telecom/roaming data and protocols (GTP, Diameter, SS7) — or strong willingness to ramp.

• CDR/SDR/TAP validation exposure a plus.

**Technical skills:**

• Strong programming and automation framework experience.

• Solid debugging skills and attention to detail.

• Good communication and a collaborative, ownership mindset.

**Good to have:**

• Performance/load testing exposure (JMeter, k6, Gatling).

• Big data pipeline testing (Hadoop, Spark, Kafka).

• OpenShift/Kubernetes and cloud-native testing.

• Roaming analytics / telecom product QE background.

**Work Experience:**
5–8 years in test automation / SDET roles

**Educational Qualification:**
BE. / B.Tech., M.E./M.Tech. or M. Sc. in Computer Science / Electronics Engineering / MCA

**Location:**
Bangalore

title: Principal Engineer, Test Automation,
description:
**This is where**
your work makes a difference.
  
  
At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
  
  
Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
  
  
Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.
  
  
We are seeking a Principal Automation Engineer to define automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. The ideal candidate is a systems-oriented Quality Engineer who understands how products and services interconnect, sees the broader product architecture, and can decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. This hands-on role will lead the development of scalable C#/.NET frameworks, establish CI/CD quality gates, guide cross-team adoption, and resolve complex automation and testability challenges across distributed products.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Own the enterprise-grade automation architecture and roadmap for C#-based REST API, UI, integration, and workflow testing.
* Design modular frameworks with reusable libraries for configuration, service clients, page or component objects, test data, parallel execution, retries, logging, reporting, and environment management.
* Define coding standards, branching and review practices, framework governance, versioning, documentation, and contribution models.
* Establish pipeline strategy for pull-request validation, daily smoke tests, staged regression, release qualification, and automated quality gates.
* Guide teams on automation suitability, testability, coverage modelling, risk-based selection, and reduction of flaky or low-value tests.
* Lead technical reviews, proofs of concept, framework migrations, tool evaluations, and resolution of complex cross-service failures.
* Define dashboards and metrics for coverage, reliability, execution time, defect containment, failure causes, and productivity gains.
* Partner with architecture, software, DevOps, cybersecurity, systems, and verification leaders to embed quality throughout delivery.
* Mentor automation engineers and build engineering capability through reusable assets, coaching, and technical communities of practice.

**What You’ll Bring**

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* 10 years of experience defining automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Mandatory: Systems-oriented Quality Engineer with a strong understanding of how products, services, and components interconnect; able to see the broader product architecture and decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically.
* Mandatory: Hands-on Automation Architect with advanced C# and .NET skills and a strong understanding of software design principles, dependency injection, concurrency, asynchronous execution, and extensible architecture.
* Mandatory: Hands-on experience architecting and developing REST API automation frameworks using RestSharp.
* Mandatory: Strong hands-on experience with NUnit or Selenium or playwright for test automation.
* Mandatory: Working knowledge of GraphQL (GQL) and experience validating GraphQL APIs.
* Mandatory: Solid understanding of test data management principles, strategies, and reusable data provisioning approaches.
* Mandatory: Strong awareness of Kubernetes and containerized test environments.
* Good understanding of communication protocols, particularly SIP, and hands-on exposure to SIPp for protocol-level testing.
* Expertise in API contracts, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven integrations, databases, authentication, authorization, and service virtualization.
* Deep experience with Git, CI/CD architecture, parallel execution, automated reporting, and quality gates.
* Proven ability to improve framework reliability, diagnose flaky tests, optimize execution, and drive adoption across multiple teams.
* Strong technical leadership, stakeholder communication, mentoring, and architecture decision-making skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Allure reporting is preferred.
* Experience with Postman is good to have.
* Experience with Azure, Docker, infrastructure-as-code, message brokers, observability platforms, and cloud-native test environments.
* Experience validating healthcare platforms, HL7/FHIR integrations, connected devices, or regulated software products.
* Knowledge of security, accessibility, performance, reliability, and resilience testing within a unified automation strategy.
* Relevant Microsoft, cloud, architecture, or testing certification is advantageous.
* Knowledge of SIP infrastructure and media components such as Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, SBCs, registrars, RTP, and WebRTC.
* Experience with Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, and container security tooling.
* Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software.
* Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews.
* Experience leading a team of automation testers toward a common goal.

title: Test Lead
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Test Engineer who can own quality across DataWeave's SaaS platform, spanning manual and automation testing, API and data validation, and testing of AI and ML driven features such as pricing insights, recommendations, and LLM powered outputs. This role requires strong testing fundamentals, comfort building and maintaining automation frameworks, and the judgment to design test strategies for features whose outputs are probabilistic rather than deterministic. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and data science to ensure releases are reliable, performant, and trustworthy at scale.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Design, execute, and maintain test plans and test cases for new features, covering functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing across the DataWeave platform.
* Build and extend automation test suites (UI and API) using frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress, integrated into CI/CD pipelines for fast, reliable feedback.
* Own API testing end to end: functional, contract, negative, and performance testing of REST and internal service APIs using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or equivalent.
* Define and execute test strategies for AI and ML driven features (LLM based insights, recommendations, classification, and NLP or computer vision pipelines), including evaluation of output accuracy, consistency, edge cases, hallucination checks, and regression across model or prompt changes.
* Validate large scale data pipelines and outputs for correctness, completeness, and consistency, working closely with data engineering and data science teams.
* Set up and maintain test data, environments, and mocks needed for repeatable manual and automated testing.
* Triage defects, drive root cause analysis with engineering, and track quality metrics (coverage, defect leakage, automation ROI) to improve release quality over time.
* Contribute to test strategy, tooling choices, and best practices, and mentor junior QA engineers on the team.
* Participate in sprint planning, story grooming, and release readiness reviews, representing the quality and testability point of view.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* 4 to 7 years of overall QA/testing experience, with a strong mix of manual and automation testing in a SaaS or product engineering environment.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining automation frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar) and integrating them into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar).
* Strong experience in API testing (REST, JSON/XML payloads) using Postman, RestAssured, or comparable tools, including contract and performance testing.
* Practical exposure to testing AI/ML or LLM powered features, such as evaluating model outputs, prompt regression, accuracy and precision/recall style metrics, or building golden datasets for evaluation.
* Solid understanding of SQL and the ability to validate data in large datasets or data warehouses.
* Working knowledge of scripting or programming (Python, Java, or JavaScript) for automation and data validation scripts.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery, defect tracking (Jira), and test management tools.
* Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to reason about edge cases in complex, data heavy, AI driven systems.
* Excellent communication skills and comfort working directly with engineering, product, and data science stakeholders.
* Proficiency in using at least one of the AI Developer Productivity Tools (like Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor..)
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

title: Solution Test Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
**About the Opportunity:**
At Ericsson, we're shaping the future of connectivity through cutting-edge 5G and cloud-native technologies. We're looking for a Solution Test Engineer to lead end-to-end testing, system integration, automation, and validation of Ericsson Private 5G solutions ( BEWS - Private Networks). In this role, you'll work across 5G Core, RAN, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms, drive quality through automation and CI/CD, troubleshoot complex network issues, and collaborate with global teams to deliver world-class telecom solutions.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Test Design & Execution: Design and execute detailed E2E system test plans for Ericsson Private 5G (EP5G) solutions, ensuring full coverage of 3GPP features and customer use cases.
* System Integration: Integrate and validate 5G components, including Cloud-Native Core (cn5GC), RAN, and Management/Orchestration platforms, ensuring seamless interoperability.
* Advanced Validation: Own the E2E validation for specific feature sets across performance, scaling, and stability, utilizing CI/CD pipelines for automated regression.
* Protocol Debugging: Perform deep-dive troubleshooting of complex call flows using tools like Wireshark/QXDM to analyze NAS/AS signaling and interfaces (N1, N2, N3, etc.).
* Automation Development: Develop and maintain automated test scripts within a Python/Robot Framework environment to increase test velocity and reliability.
* Stability & Performance Testing: Design and run soak tests, stress tests, and load models to identify memory leaks and system bottlenecks before deployment.
* Mentorship: Provide technical guidance to junior engineers, conduct peer reviews of test cases, and contribute to the team's internal knowledge base.

**Skills You Bring**
Bachelor’s/Master’s in CS, EE, or related field with 6–8 years of experience in Telecom/Network testing.
  
  
5G/4G Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of 3GPP architectures and protocols (NGAP, S1AP, RRC, HTTP/2). Ability to analyze multi-interface traces to isolate faults.
  
  
Cloud-Native Skills: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, and Helm. Understanding of K8s networking (Services, Load Balancers, and CNI basics) is essential.
  
  
Networking Foundations: Solid knowledge of L2/L3 networking, including IPV4/V6, VLANs, Routing, and familiarity with OSPF/BGP.
  
  
Automation Proficiency: Strong Python scripting skills and experience with Robot Framework (or similar) to automate complex system-level scenarios.
  
  
System Validation Expertise: Proven ability to design test cases for performance (throughput/latency), scaling, and stability (soak/reliability).
  
  
Infrastructure & Tools: Proficiency in Linux/Unix environments. Experience with industry tools such as Spirent (Landslide), Keysight, or Viavi.
  
  
**“All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.”**

**Job Description**
As a Software Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products through comprehensive test planning, test execution, and defect management. You will work closely with developers and product teams to identify and address potential issues early in the software development lifecycle. You will be expected to write automated tests using Python and the Robot Framework, contribute to test processes, and manage end-to-end testing to ensure our software products deliver the best user experience.

* Test Planning & Strategy:

+ Develop comprehensive test plans and test strategies for software applications based on requirements and specifications.
+ Define test cases, test data, and create a clear roadmap for testing activities.

* Automated Testing:

+ Write, maintain, and execute automated test scripts using Python and Robot Framework.
+ Design and develop reusable and scalable automated tests for both functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., performance, security).
+ Integrate automated tests with Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.

* End-to-End Testing:

+ Lead and perform end-to-end testing for the entire software product, ensuring that all parts of the system work together as expected.
+ Conduct regression testing, smoke testing, and functional testing across multiple environments.
+ Identify, reproduce, and document defects and work with development teams to ensure timely resolution.

* Test Execution & Reporting:

+ Execute both manual and automated test cases across various platforms (web, desktop, etc.).
+ Track, report, and prioritize defects and issues found during testing, ensuring proper communication with relevant teams.
+ Ensure thorough test coverage by validating the full functionality of the product, including edge cases.

* Continuous Improvement:

+ Collaborate with development teams to improve the testing process, quality practices, and automation strategies.
+ Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives to continuously improve testing workflows.

* Collaboration & Communication:

+ Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements, review user stories, and ensure proper test coverage.

+ Proficient in Python programming for test automation and scripting.

title: Manager, Quality Engineering (TCF)
description:
**Job Title**
Manager, Quality Engineering (TCF)
  
  
**Job Description**
We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.
  
  
The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.
  
  
The Concentrix Technical Products and Services team is the driving force behind Concentrix’s transformation, data, and technology services. We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.
  
  
Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.
  
  
Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.
  
  
***Role Overview***
*We are looking for an experienced Technical Manager – QA to lead QA delivery and Quality Engineering initiatives. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise across QA Automation, Functional Testing, AI-driven Testing, Agentic Automation, People Management, Client Management, and SOW/Delivery Management.
  
  
The candidate should be able to provide both technical leadership and delivery leadership, while driving the adoption of modern AI-powered and agentic automation approaches within QA.*
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead QA teams and provide technical and delivery leadership across projects.
* Define and drive QA strategy, test approach, automation strategy, and quality engineering practices.
* Strong experience in Functional Testing, System Testing, Integration Testing, Regression Testing, and End-to-End Testing.
* Strong experience in Test Automation, including designing, developing, and maintaining automation frameworks.
* Drive adoption of AI-powered testing and Agentic Automation to improve QA productivity, coverage, and efficiency.
* Design and implement Agentic Automation solutions where AI agents can understand requirements, generate/execute test scenarios, analyze results, identify defects, and support test maintenance.
* Evaluate and leverage Generative AI / LLM capabilities for test automation, test case generation, test data creation, defect analysis, and QA productivity.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to QA engineers and automation teams.
* Manage team performance, resource allocation, utilization, skill development, and career growth.
* Work closely with clients, business stakeholders, Product Owners, Developers, and other delivery teams.
* Own QA delivery and proactively manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and quality metrics.
* Participate in SOW preparation, effort estimation, resource planning, scope definition, milestones, and deliverables.
* Support SOW execution, change requests, project extensions, and scope-related discussions.
* Prepare and present QA status, metrics, risks, and delivery updates to senior stakeholders and clients.
* Drive continuous improvement and adoption of modern QA, AI, and automation practices.
* Support hiring, technical evaluation, onboarding, and capability development of QA resources.

***Must-Have Skills***

* 12+ years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Engineering.
* Strong experience in both Functional Testing and Test Automation.
* Proven experience in QA Team / People Management.
* Strong experience in Client and Stakeholder Management.
* Hands-on experience with SOW, estimation, resource planning, and delivery management.
* Strong understanding of STLC, SDLC, Agile/Scrum, and QA methodologies.
* Experience with UI and API automation.
* Good programming knowledge in Java, C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript.
* Mandatory experience/exposure to AI-driven QA / AI-based Test Automation.
* Mandatory exposure/experience in Agentic Automation, including AI agents or agent-based approaches for software testing and automation.
* Understanding of Generative AI / LLMs, AI-assisted test generation, test execution, defect analysis, or test maintenance.
* Experience using AI tools/platforms such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar AI/LLM-based solutions for QA/automation is preferred.
* Experience with CI/CD and version-control tools such as Jenkins, GitLab, Git, etc.
* Excellent communication, leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

title: Advanced Engineer, Audio System Validation
description:
**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive**
We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.
  
  

* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
* Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
* Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
As a Advanced Engineer, Audio System Validation, you are responsible for safeguarding system trust across the technology development lifecycle.
  
  
You apply deep DSP and system-level expertise to validate algorithmic correctness, detect regression risks, and ensure that measurable performance standards are met throughout development and prior to release.
  
  
Operating within the EPIC Validation Team, you contribute primarily by embedding technical validation and automated guardrails directly into development workflows.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Perform white-box validation of DSP algorithms and system-level audio processing.
* Design and execute structured signal-based validation scenarios.
* Detect artifacts, performance regression, latency issues, and algorithmic instability.
* Define measurable validation criteria aligned with System Trust standards.
* Collaborate with developers to integrate repeatable validation checks into CI environments.
* Analyze complex technical findings and translate them into actionable engineering feedback.
* Support final validation by providing technical root-cause analysis when required.
* Contribute to the evolution of automated guardrails and regression protection strategies

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**

* Strong background (5+ years) in Digital Signal Processing (DSP), audio algorithms, or embedded audio systems
* Academic background with a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Sound Engineering / Electrical Engineering / Signal Processing or equivalent
* Solid understanding of software development workflows and integration environments
* Experience performing white-box technical validation and root-cause analysis.
* Ability to independently solve moderately complex technical problems.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured documentation skills
* Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to cross-functional teams

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Experience integrating automated validation into CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with performance testing in embedded systems
* Exposure to perceptual audio implications of DSP decisions
* Experience in automotive or resource-constrained systems.
* Knowledge of measurement tools and signal analysis environments
* Valid driver's license
* Proficiency in on site native language

**Things To Know**

* 10% travel might require.
* Willingness to work in a HARMAN office located in Bengaluru, India
* Successfully completing a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment

**What You Can Expect**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
* Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being
* Tuition reimbursement support
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

**You Belong Here**
HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
  
  
**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology**

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
  
  
If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!
